description: Select an available item in the inventory.
objective: Verify that selecting an item updates its selected state.
preconditions: The player has an available item in the inventory.
expectedResult: The selected item is visibly marked as selected.

gherkin.given: the player has an available item
gherkin.then: the item should be marked as selected

description: Use an item from the inventory.
objective: Verify that a usable item can be activated from the inventory.
preconditions: The player has a usable item in the inventory.
expectedResult: The item effect is applied and the inventory reflects its updated state.

gherkin.given: the player has a usable item
gherkin.when: the player chooses Use for that item
gherkin.then: the item effect should be applied and the inventory should be updated

description: Move the player using the configured movement input.
objective: Verify that player movement responds to input and respects the scene boundaries.
expectedResult: The player moves in the requested direction and remains within the playable area.

gherkin.scenario: Move the player within the playable area
gherkin.given: a playable scene is loaded and the player is active
gherkin.when: the player provides movement input toward a scene boundary
gherkin.then: the character should move in the requested direction and remain within the playable area

description: Persist player progress and restore it after loading a saved game.
objective: Verify that saved progress is available after restarting the game.
preconditions: The player has made progress that can be saved.
expectedResult: The game restores the progress recorded in the save.

gherkin.given: the player has saved game progress
gherkin.when: the player restarts the game and loads that save
gherkin.then: the saved progress should be restored

description: Apply the configured combat action to a valid target.
objective: Verify that combat input affects the target and updates combat state.
preconditions: The player can perform the combat action.
expectedResult: The target receives the configured effect and combat state is updated.

gherkin.scenario: Perform a combat action on a valid target
gherkin.given: a valid target is present and the player can act
gherkin.when: the player performs the combat action while aiming at the target
gherkin.then: the target should receive the configured effect and combat state should be updated

description: Open and close the pause menu during gameplay.
objective: Verify that the pause menu and gameplay state stay synchronized.
expectedResult: The menu is displayed while paused and gameplay resumes when it is closed.

gherkin.when: the player opens and then closes the pause menu
gherkin.then: the menu should be displayed while paused and gameplay should resume when it closes
